transform_convention: location = connector centre in module space; heading_deg = direction of travel through the connector, counter-clockwise from +X about +Z.  To attach B after A: T_B = T_A * Translate(A.exit.location) * RotZ(A.exit.heading). Every module entry is its own origin with heading 0, except the bridgehead pieces, which share one frame.

connector_types.ROAD_3M: Full road section: 3.00 m surface (Y=±1.50, Z=0) plus 0.75 m edge band each side with a 0.04 m verge hump; 25 vertices at Y = -2.25..-1.50 step 0.125, -1.25..1.25 step 0.25, 1.50..2.25 step 0.125.
connector_types.ROAD_EDGE_L: Left edge band only: Y = +1.50..+2.25 step 0.125 (7 vertices).  Joins ROAD_3M edges and TEST_RoadCore_3m.
connector_types.ROAD_EDGE_R: Right edge band only: Y = -2.25..-1.50 step 0.125 (7 vertices).
connector_types.BANK_0_TO_MINUS_0P8: Bank section across the bank line: land +1.00 m at Z=0, crest at 0, smoothstep slope through the test water level -0.80 to the toe -1.00 at 2.00 m on the water side; 25 vertices step 0.125.  Land is on the left of the travel direction.
connector_types.BRIDGE_3M: Test deck seat: 3.00 m wide, Z=+0.15, 13 vertices Y=-1.50..1.50 step 0.25.
connector_types.GROUND_3M: Flat ground line Z=0, 3.00 m wide.
connector_types.GROUND_EDGE: Open edge resting on flat ground Z=0.
connector_types.BRIDGEHEAD_FIELD: Internal seam of the bridgehead set; both sides sample the same height field c_H on the same lattice.
connector_types.BRIDGE_SEAT: Top face of the stone base, Z=-0.05, under the 0.20 m test deck.
connector_types.RIVERBED_EDGE: River-side open edge at the toe depth (Z=-1.00 at the bank connectors).

bounds_note: Bounds are measured from all exported meshes (details included; grass cards may overhang free outer edges, never entry/exit planes).
